errors.evidence: The green line representing EU is not at 0.000. It is flat at a constant value slightly above 0.000 for all decoding temperatures.
The description incorrectly states the EU line has no markers. The figure clearly shows that the green EU line has circular markers at each data point, identical to the AU and TU lines.
At a decoding temperature of 0.4, the value for the AU and TU lines is approximately 0.123, not 0.120. The description slightly exaggerates the small dip in the data.
